title: The teachers on the validation episodes of the confirmed controllers
description: Cubic and BBRv3 themselves, the teachers the discovery controllers were cloned from, on the same validation episodes as the grounding of the confirmed controllers (exp-ground-rl-confirm-32): the campaign of the confirmation's setup (release exp-controller-rl-confirm-31, setup/eval/campaign.json), the same pairs and seeds, every step kept, the episode length of the references' spec. ground.py rollouts --stock drives a Linux controller in place of a policy; the training-link rollouts are cut to one episode, because nothing is fitted to a teacher. The plan reports each controller against the teachers themselves (docs/methodology.md, plan step 2); against a controller not trained on this objective the signed difference is reported by kind of condition, with no verdict (comparing controllers, rule 4). A later run sets the references and widths of exp-ground-rl-confirm-32 against these rollouts with experiments/versus_reference.py. One run per teacher: Linux controllers are deterministic up to the episode seeds, which are the same as the grounding's. The test links are not read.
run: case "$TEACHER" in cubic) P="lr0.0003-c0.2-n0.2";; bbr3) P="lr0.00003-c0.2-n0.1";; *) exit 2;; esac; R="stock-$TEACHER-s1"; mkdir -p "$OUT/$R"; cp "$IN/runs/ctl-$TEACHER-k0-s1-$P/ppo_spec.json" "$OUT/$R/"; uv run python experiments/ground.py rollouts "$OUT/$R" --stock "$TEACHER" --links 1 --fit "$IN/runs/setup/paths/campaign.json" --score "$IN/runs/setup/eval/campaign.json" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
